subject.title: [Bug]: Heartbeat poll session: direct text reply not delivered to QQ user

question: Should heartbeat poll direct text replies auto-route to QQ C2C from session context, or should QQ heartbeat notifications require explicit message-tool targeting unless a narrower route-source contract is designed?
rationale: The straightforward implementation was closed unmerged because it relaxes a cross-channel delivery guard, so automation cannot choose between delivery convenience and privacy-safe routing policy.

options.title: Keep Explicit Targeting Until Narrow Fix
options.body: Require explicit QQBot C2C targets for now and accept only a later fix that preserves cross-channel guard semantics and includes live QQ proof.

options.title: Approve Automatic QQ Heartbeat Routing
options.body: Allow automatic QQ C2C heartbeat routing, but require a narrow route-source design, regression tests for cross-channel isolation, and redacted live QQ proof before merge.

options.title: Resolve As Documentation Contract
options.body: Close the product gap by documenting that QQ heartbeat alerts must use explicit message-tool targeting instead of implicit last-recipient routing.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Targeting Until Narrow Fix
recommendation.body: Require explicit QQBot C2C targets for now and accept only a later fix that preserves cross-channel guard semantics and includes live QQ proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is tied to recent fail-closed shared-session routing history and is the best available owner for the policy choice between automatic routing and preserving the guard.
